item.title: #103: prove topic list page N is requested as page N (tests only)
item.body:
Closes #103
Claim: ext/bybifok-opus-1
Author model: Opus 5.5

**Problem.** Legacy rewrote a topic-list URL for page N by appending `?page=N` to `liste_sujet-1.htm` (`TopicPageURLRouting.replacingPage`, `HFRswift/Swift/Common.swift:2750-2759` on `master`: the path has no `page=` and no `_N.htm`, so it falls through to adding a query item). HFR ignores that query: the header said "page 11" and page 1 was shown. Found and fixed in legacy by Bybifok (`a817498`, ezzz/HFRnow#3).

**Does SwiftHFR have it? No.**
- `ForumCatalogue.topicListPath` (`Packages/HFRKit/Sources/HFRModels/Catalogue/ForumCatalogue+TopicListPath.swift:6-9`), used by `HFREndpoint.topicList`, always builds `forum1.php?config=hfr.inc&cat=C&page=N&subcat=&owntopic=F`.
- `HFRLinkRoute` reads the page from the path for canonical lists (`liste_sujet-N.htm`) and from `page=` for `forum1.php` (`HFRLinkRoute+Routing.swift:52-68, 93-105`).
- No code builds `liste_sujet-1.htm?page=N`. The app pages sub-forums with `SubforumPath`, already tested by `SubforumPathTests.replacesThePageOfAListPath`.

**Change.** Tests only, as the issue's scope asks (step 2), plus a CHANGELOG-LEGACY row.

## Tests
New suite `TopicListPageRequestTests` (HFRClientTests, so that the builder of HFRNetwork, the parser and the router of HFRParsing are checked together), on the captures `R04` (page 1), `R05a` (page 12) and `R05b` (page 500):
- `endpointRequestsTheCapturedPage`: `HFREndpoint.topicList(category: .forum(13), page: N).url` equals the capture's requested URL (meta `url`) and has no `liste_sujet`. The meta also shows HFR's own answer: one 301 to `/hfr/Discussions/liste_sujet-N.htm`, final URL `…/liste_sujet-N.htm`, and the page parses with `navigation.current == N`.
- `routerKeepsThePage`: `HFRLinkRoute.route(for:)` gives the same `.topicList(page: N)` for the `forum1.php` request and for the canonical final URL.
- `pagerLinksRouteToTheirPage`: every pager link the parser returns (first, last, next, previous) routes to the page it names, and none carries `?page=`.

**The tests fail when the code regresses** (each mutation applied, then reverted):
- the builder writes `page=1` whatever N: `endpointRequestsTheCapturedPage` fails;
- the router reads a canonical list path as page 1: `routerKeepsThePage` and `pagerLinksRouteToTheirPage` fail;
- the router ignores `page=` on `forum1.php`: `routerKeepsThePage` fails.

Other checks:
- `swift test` in `Packages/HFRKit` on macOS: 1029 tests pass.
- `python3 scripts/check-lot-deps.py`: 0 violations.
- `markdownlint-cli2@0.18.1` on the CHANGELOG: 0 errors.
- SwiftLint is not installed here, so the LESSONS 21 list was checked by hand.

## LEGACY FIXES
- `docs/CHANGELOG-LEGACY.md` row 38 (UX): "page N" of a list really loads page N. Source: `Common.swift:2750-2759`, captures `R05a`, `R05b`, legacy fix `a817498`.

## PENDING CAPTURE
- The logged-in answer to `forum1.php?…&page=N` for N ≥ 2 (HFR-PROTOCOL §7b B2, #278). `R08-2` only shows page 1 logged in: 200 in place, no redirect. Not guessed here; the tests read only the anonymous captures.

## Adversarial review
By a fresh **Fable** sub-agent (author model Opus). As the issue asks, it gets only: the diff, these metadata lines, the LOT-041 and LOT-095 specs, AGENTS.md, LESSONS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md and HFR-PROTOCOL.md. Its verdict will be posted verbatim.
